# Feature Intake Template

Copy this into a new Beads epic description when a feature is proposed.

## Summary
- **One-liner:** (crisp, user-facing)
- **Problem / Job-to-be-done:** (who, what pain, why now)

## Context & Constraints
- Domain/background:
- Existing behavior:
- Hard constraints (perf, security, compliance, device, locale, offline, etc.):
- Out of scope:

## Stakeholders
- Requestor:
- PM/Owner:
- Engineering lead:
- QA/Validator:

## Acceptance Criteria
- Bullet, testable statements of expected behavior.
- Include error/edge cases.

## Success Metrics
- Primary (e.g., task success rate, latency, conversions):
- Secondary (e.g., support tickets, crash-free):

## Dependencies / Risks
- External services, migrations, feature flags, data seeds:
- Known risks and mitigations:

## Decomposition Notes (for bead generation)
- Suggested sub-areas (discovery, design, backend, frontend, docs, tests, rollout).
- Required artifacts (diagrams, traces, captures).

## Testing & Validation Plan
- Unit coverage expectations:
- Integration/e2e flows:
- Non-functional (perf, a11y, i18n, security):
- Trace/capture requirements (Peekaboo, trace recorder, logs to attach):

## Rollout / Ops
- Flags/guards:
- Monitoring/alerts to add:
- Backout plan:

## Timeline
- Target milestone/date:
- Checkpoints:

## Notes / References
- Links to designs, tickets, prior incidents, related code areas.
